# RosterSEO

> RosterSEO is an open-source, self-hosted platform that unifies SEO, AI-answer-engine visibility tracking, and multi-platform content publishing. MIT licensed.

RosterSEO tracks how a site ranks in classic search (Google) and how it's mentioned by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity), audits site health, and publishes content across 10 blog platforms and 8 social platforms — all from one self-hosted instance the operator fully controls. Every number shown is backed by a real API call (DataForSEO, Google APIs, or an AI provider); nothing is fabricated.

## Product
- [Features](https://rosterseo.com/features): Full feature list — Page Analyzer, Site Audit, Rank Tracking, Keyword Research, AI Visibility, Local SEO, Cappy (in-app AI agent), Publish, Social.
- [How it works](https://rosterseo.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step, from self-hosting to first published post.
- [Integrations](https://rosterseo.com/integrations): Every blog and social platform connection.
- [Pricing](https://rosterseo.com/pricing): Self-hosted is free forever; hosted cloud is coming.
